method.primary: GitHub REST metadata and raw README inspection
method.scope: Krea2 and ComfyUI community implementations relevant to canonical Albina restyling

candidates.finding: The target_latent pixel path prevents mid-sampling VAE encoding and can avoid severe VRAM offload slowdowns. v1.2 also documents a high-fidelity 1024-to-1.5MP operating range.
candidates.reason: Requires a separate Identity Edit LoRA and edit-model semantics; it is an editor path, not proof-preserving six-LoRA material restyling. It may be investigated later for non-canonical AU or local edits.

candidates.finding: The recommended single-reference route separates style strength from reference-content leakage and is explicitly intended to preserve Krea2 native quality.
candidates.reason: A reference image must be style-only and must not become a second Albina content source. It cannot replace canonical latent origin or the fixed six-LoRA chain.

candidates.finding: Role-separated references and a prepared-reference preview are useful for scene and CG experiments, but the project warns that multiple references compete and that identity preservation needs a dedicated subject card.
candidates.reason: Do not introduce a reference stack into the canonical character production path until a fixed-seed direct image review proves no geometry, side-assignment, or composition drift.

candidates.finding: Reference latents are ignored by stock Krea2 unless the edit model patch is present; KV cache is only correct for LoRAs trained with the matching model option.
candidates.reason: The current six-LoRA production chain is not an edit-LoRA chain and no matching KV-cache training contract is verified.

candidates.finding: This is a compatibility patch for an existing KJNodes install, not a standalone node pack. Its README reports validation against newer ComfyUI and SageAttention versions.
candidates.reason: The local ComfyUI is 0.28.3 and the project is running with low VRAM; changing attention/runtime components without a bounded anchor A/B would risk another expensive failure.

styleReferenceNodeCompatibility.reason: The local node produces a remote Krea API style-reference handle; it cannot connect to the local MODEL/CONDITIONING/LATENT sockets of UNETLoader -> six LoraLoaderModelOnly -> SamplerCustomAdvanced.

productionDecision.why: It is the only locally verified route that keeps canonical latent origin, restores canonical alpha, preserves the fixed six-LoRA order, and adds a bounded high-frequency refinement pass without introducing an unverified identity/reference model.
productionDecision.qualityCaveat: A receipt proving the six LoRAs ran is not visual acceptance. Soft output or weak mechanical separation remains rejected after direct image reading.
productionDecision.nextPermittedExperiment: One fixed-seed Albina anchor A/B only: compare the current two-pass profile against a bounded native Krea2 img2img schedule or a style-reference staging branch; no batch generation until direct review passes.
productionDecision.promotionRule: No candidate is promoted without direct original-resolution image review, canonical hash binding, workflow/topology receipt, and rights review.
